program: NAISS (National Academic Infrastructure for Supercomputing in Sweden), which replaced SNIC on 1 Jan 2023: SUPR compute rounds Small/Medium/Large; Alvis closed (decommissioned); Berzelius is a separate KAW-funded round (LiU Berzelius 2026) in SUPR
next_step_program: EuroHPC JU AI Factories Fast Lane Access (Industrial Innovation track, 2026 call EHPC-AIF-2026FL), with application support from Sweden AI Factory (formerly Mimer AI Factory, NAISS/LiU and RISE)
stopper_list: NAISS compute free only to researchers at Swedish universities/research institutes; company cannot apply; Swedish shares of Arrhenius/LUMI academic only (https://www.naiss.se/allocations/ ; https://supr.naiss.se/round/eurohpc/)
Small: PI at least PhD student with >=20% appointment at Swedish university/VR-recognised institute (https://user.naiss.se/allocations/small/ ; https://supr.naiss.se/round/2026small/)
Medium/Large: PI at least assistant professor with >=60% appointment; Large also needs Medium PI track record (https://user.naiss.se/allocations/medium/ ; https://user.naiss.se/allocations/)
Small cap 500 GPU-h/month on Arrhenius GPU, far below 20-30k GPU-h; Medium evaluated monthly (submit by 15th, start 1st) (https://supr.naiss.se/round/2026small/ ; https://user.naiss.se/allocations/)
Alvis cannot be applied for: decommissioned/retired, allocations move to Arrhenius (https://supr.naiss.se/round/2026small/ ; https://www.c3se.chalmers.se/)

Berzelius (KAW, not NAISS): PI >= assistant professor with KAW affiliation; project within it, AI/ML, intended for publication, no sensitive data (https://www.nsc.liu.se/support/systems/berzelius-resource-allocation ; https://supr.naiss.se/round/berzelius2026)
NAISS terms of use: services only for the granted research purpose; results published unless a commercial contract says otherwise (https://www.naiss.se/policies/terms-of-use/)

Fast Lane: applicant is an industry organisation (company/SME/startup) established in EU MS or associated country, PI affiliated; free only for AI SMEs/startups for innovation (ToR s.2 https://www.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/document/download/bd7aa666-bdf3-4436-b5ec-0b34a781e817_en ; https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/ai-factories/ai-factories-access-modes_en)
PI employed at submission and for >=3 months after allocation end (ToR s.2c)
Proof of status: valid VAT number (and PIC if applicable) (ToR s.2)
Professional e-mail addresses; portal registration requires organisation's official e-mail (ToR s.4 ; https://access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/auth/register)
HPC-ready users; technical feasibility data mandatory at submission or administrative rejection; AI Factory technical assessment (ToR s.1.2, s.5.1.1, s.6d)

Up to 50,000 GPU-h on a single system; first come first served until reserved resources run out; MN5 ACC and JUPITER Booster currently unavailable (https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/fast-lane-access-ai-factories_en ; ToR s.5.1.1)
Minimum request 10,000 GPU-h per proposal (systems table, https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/fast-lane-access-ai-factories_en)
Allocation 1, 2 or 3 months; no extensions, no additional resources (ToR s.1.2, s.4 ; https://swedenaifactory.se/about/faq/)
One Fast Lane award per PI at a time; no double award for a project with a running EuroHPC allocation (ToR s.1.2, s.2)
Civilian purpose, AI Act compliance, eligibility and ethics self-assessment; English only (ToR s.2, s.5.1.1)

Training/fine-tuning only: no production use, inference only a small justified share (EuroHPC Access Policy s.1.6 https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/document/download/30614065-6dd6-4206-8065-fc97948e5e2c_en)

Open call is the 2026 Fast Lane call EHPC-AIF-2026FL, 2026-01-21 to 2026-12-31; the access-calls page's Apply Now links to the closed 2025 call; no 2027 call published (https://access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/calls/59 ; https://api.access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/v2/calls/published)
Sign the AI Factory Acceptable Use Policy before access; onboarding by the AI Factory (ToR s.5.1)

Final report within 3 months incl. energy use and carbon footprint; EuroHPC may publish after 1 year; publish results except confidential parts and acknowledge EuroHPC/AI Factory; usage monitored monthly (ToR s.1.4, s.4 ; Access Policy s.3.3.1.4)

A: Arrhenius called academic ('som också är akademiskt') and founder told they will likely run on another EuroHPC system elsewhere in Europe; Arrhenius GPU (NAISS, SE) is offered in Fast Lane via its EuroHPC share (https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/fast-lane-access-ai-factories_en ; https://supr.naiss.se/round/eurohpc/)

Submit Fast Lane on Monday 4 January 2027 with access around 8-12 January: no 2027 Fast Lane call is published, the open 2026 call ends 2026-12-31, and last cycle the new call opened only on 21 January (mitigated: A tells the founder to ask Sweden AI Factory first)
